# openstatus_status_page (Data Source)

Look up an existing status page by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openstatus_status_page" "main" {
  id = "456"
}

output "status_page_slug" {
  value = data.openstatus_status_page.main.slug
}
```
